why: ★★ THE LAYOUT-DEPENDENT FIXTURE — the slug is the LAYOUT'S to derive, never the model's to choose. The old SKILL documented the slug as `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,62}$` (ASCII, <=63) while the validator actually accepted Unicode up to 120 chars — and `prepare`'s envelope had 7 keys and NO layout information at all, so it never told the model the strategy. A weak model OBEYS the doc: on the operator's LIVE vault (obsidian-personal / preserve-unicode / Russian) it emits an ASCII slug like `slippage` for «Проскальзывание», the page is written, and every inbound `[[Проскальзывание]]` resolves — through the SAME `_apply_slug_strategy` — to `проскальзывание`. The freshly written page never resolves its own inbound wikilink. NOTHING links to it. That is exactly the live `виталик-бутерин` / `vitalik-buterin` split. TASK 064 adds `slug_strategy` to the envelope and G8 (`SLUG_NOT_DERIVED_FROM_NAME`, `_gates.py`) enforces it. MECHANISM-BACKED on the slugifying layouts (verified: cybos -> derived_slug `proskalzyvanie`; obsidian-personal -> derived_slug `проскальзывание`), and LEGITIMATELY ACCEPTED on karpathy — `derive_concept_slug` returns None under `identity` and the gate is SKIPPED, because `identity` is a STEM->slug function, not a NAME->slug one: the stem IS the slug, so a candidate's slug is self-consistent by definition and there is nothing to verify. ★ RUNNER CONTRACT: derive each expected item's slug with `_gates.derive_concept_slug(name, slug_strategy)`, NOT with a bare `_apply_slug_strategy(name, ...)`. On identity the latter returns `Проскальзывание` — uppercase, and `_is_valid_slug` REFUSES it (measured: False), so a naive runner would make this fixture's own expected.json un-appliable on karpathy. Under identity `derive_concept_slug` returns None and the runner must supply any `_is_valid_slug`-valid slug of its own. ★ THE UNENFORCEABLE HALF (census-only, `forbidden`): the note is seeded with the junk the old contract really minted, and NO gate stops any of it. `Slippage` as a SECOND, Latin-named page for the same idea is the real split reproduced — G5 does not catch it (measured similarity of the transliterated dup-keys `proskalzyvanie` / `slippage` = 0.273, far under the 0.88 cutoff). `тултип` is UI chrome and passes every mechanical gate. `Марк Ковалёв` is refused ONLY if the model self-declares `entity_type: person`; filed as `concept` a person sails through. `block_number` is enforced by accident and only on ONE layout: preserve-unicode keeps the `_` so INVALID_SLUG_CHARSET fires, while transliterate derives `block-number` and NOTHING refuses it. Do not mistake these greens for coverage — the census IS the gate here.
